In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed model presents an interesting and promising approach to the analysis of endogenous cycles in a dynamic economy.
our model provides a framework to analyze the macroeconomic effects of diffusion of GPTs and their impact on endogenous cycles and growth.
the proposed model is able to explain the co movement of the major macroeconomic indicators in a business cycle, as well as the long run economic growth.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in a model with indivisible innovations, the diffusion of major innovations, which follows a sigmoidal pattern, can be a source for endogenous cycles.
the diffusion of innovations is the driving force behind endogenous growth cycles.
we present a new mechanism for the existence of cyclical solutions in the long run and a new interpretation for the wave dynamics of these cycles.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the presence of a major innovation diffusion process, the economy can experience endogenous cycles, even when the innovation diffusion process does not have a cyclical nature.
the diffusion process of major innovations, in a large scale, is likely to have an S shape pattern.
the diffusion process of GPTs is a major source for the emergence of endogenous growth cycles.
